scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev src/scentiq_api/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --directory apps/api mypy src tests
scripts.api:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm compose:config
